facts.claim: The park has 1.3 miles of paved, level trail connecting riverbank overlooks and open green space.

facts.claim: Boone County says accessible parking is available at Giles Conrad Park, with a paved walking path to the neighboring Valley Orchards fields.
facts.quote: Handicap accessible parking is available at Gile Conrad Park (7500 River Road), along with a paved walking path to the fields.

facts.claim: The county shelter register lists Shelter 1 with 70 seats and electricity, and Shelter 2 with 80 seats and no electricity. Seating capacity does not establish wheelchair spaces or companion layout.
facts.quote: Giles Conrad Park 7500 River Road Hebron, Ky 41048 Shelter 1: Seats 70 (electricity) - $45 Shelter 2: Seats 80 (no electricity) -$45 Port-o-lets Grill

facts.claim: County shelter reservations open on the first business day in March for April–October bookings, for the whole day. Fees are non-refundable; rescheduling depends on an opening. This is countywide booking guidance, not proof of a particular date’s availability.
facts.quote: We start accepting shelter reservations the first business day in March. Shelters are available to reserve from April-October. Fees can vary depending on the size of the shelter. All fees also include tax and are non-refundable. Shelter reservations are for the entire day. Please keep in mind if you need multiple dates, you'll need to reserve each day. Shelters are outdoors. We can only reschedule your shelter reservation if there is an opening.

facts.claim: The park page gives 859-334-2283 for weather-related activity updates. This does not establish trail or toilet conditions.
facts.quote: Curious if weather impacts activities? Call us at 859-334-2283 for updates.

facts.claim: For the neighboring Valley Orchards fields, the county warns that parking at Valley Orchards involves uneven ground. It identifies parking at Giles Conrad Park, 7500 River Road, with a paved path to the fields as the alternative; path distance and slope are not stated.
facts.quote: Parking is available at Valley Orchards; be prepared to walk down uneven ground. Handicap accessible parking is available at Gile Conrad Park (7500 River Road), along with a paved walking path to the fields.

facts.claim: The park page says each of its two reservable shelters includes electricity and a grill. See the listing’s caution about the shelter register’s different electricity information.
facts.quote: Giles Conrad Park has two shelters available to reserve. Each shelter includes: Electricity Grill

facts.claim: Campbell County residents who can't visit the library because of a temporary or permanent illness or disability can get materials delivered at home, or by mail for free.
facts.quote: If you are a resident of Campbell County and cannot visit the library because of temporary or permanent illness or disability, you are eligible for our home delivery service. Materials available for delivery include regular print books, large print books, magazines, DVDs, audiobooks and CDs. Materials are selected based on your reading interests and needs. The Adult Outreach Services Assistant will deliver the materials to your home on a specified day. You may also sign up to have your materials delivered by mail for free.

facts.claim: The library helps patrons sign up for the free Kentucky Talking Book service, for anyone unable to read because of a visual or physical limitation, and the national program of braille and audio materials sent by postage-free mail.
facts.quote: Through a national network of cooperating libraries, the NLS administers a free library program of braille and audio materials circulated to eligible borrowers in the United States by postage-free mail. Kentucky Talking Books Talking Book Service is available through the Kentucky Talking Book Library. This service is provided free of charge to anyone unable to read because of a visual or physical limitation.

facts.claim: For curbside pickup at Newport, place a hold and wait for a phone, text, email or postal notification. The item must also show as Held in the account. Call or email the library if you need help accessing the account or placing the hold.
facts.quote: You can call or email us if you need help accessing your account or placing a hold. Search for an item in our catalog and click "Request Item" to place it on hold. Wait for a phone call, text, email or postal mail notifying you that your holds are ready for pickup. Follow instructions for curbside pickup below. Picking Up Items You will be notified by phone, text, email or postal mail when your holds are available for curbside pickup. Please note that your holds are not ready for pickup until you receive a notification and the items are marked as "Held" in your account.

facts.claim: Use a designated curbside parking space, then call the number on its sign with your name, library card number and space number. If no one answers, call again rather than leaving voicemail. Stay in the vehicle; staff place items inside, preferably in the trunk.
facts.quote: Park in one of the parking spots that are designated for curbside pickup. Let us know that you are outside by calling the number listed on the parking spot's sign. We will need your name, library card number and parking spot number. If a staff member doesn't answer, do not leave a voicemail message. Please call back until a staff member answers. Remain in your vehicle. A staff member will place your items directly in your vehicle, preferably into your trunk.

facts.claim: Curbside pickup requires a current physical library card; a digital-only card does not qualify.
facts.quote: Curbside pickup is available for current physical library card holders. The service is not available for digital library card holders.

facts.claim: Holds remain available for seven days after the ready notification. Someone else may collect them if they have your library card number.
facts.quote: You will have seven days to pick up your holds. Q: What if the parking spots designated for curbside pickup are full? A: If the parking spots are full, please park in another area of the parking lot until one is available. We will only deliver items to vehicles parked in the designated spots. Q: Who can pick up my items? A: Anyone may pick up your items. They must have your library card number in order to do so. Staff will not release items to those without a library card number.

facts.claim: If all curbside spaces are occupied, wait elsewhere in the lot until one opens. Staff deliver only to vehicles in the designated spaces.
facts.quote: If the parking spots are full, please park in another area of the parking lot until one is available. We will only deliver items to vehicles parked in the designated spots.

facts.claim: Items can be returned inside or to the red return bins outside the branches. The page does not give the outdoor bin’s slot height or reach measurements.
facts.quote: Items may be returned inside or by using the red item return bins that are outside each of our branches.

facts.claim: For event accommodations, the district asks for at least 72 hours’ notice by emailing access@cc-pl.org or calling extension 8 at the local branch.
facts.quote: Please email access@cc-pl.org or call ext. 8 at your local branch at least 72 hours prior to an event to arrange for accommodation.

facts.claim: To arrange adult outreach, call 859-572-5035, extension 352. Home-delivery materials include regular and large-print books, magazines, DVDs, audiobooks and CDs; selection follows the reader’s interests and needs.
facts.quote: If you'd like to set up one of these services, call our Adult Outreach Services Assistant at 859-572-5035, ext. 352. Book Talks Our Adult Outreach Services Assistant is available to host monthly book talks at senior centers, adult day care facilities, retirement living homes and extended care facilities. This service differs from a book club in that no particular book is selected to be read by each participant. Instead, topics of interest vary and a presentation is given to educate attendees and encourage intellectually stimulating discussion. Deposit Collections Deposit collections are books loaned to nursing homes, senior centers and other community agencies throughout Campbell County. Collections of 20-30 items are specially selected for each site. Deposit collections may contain an assortment of large print and regular print books, magazines, audiobooks, CDs and DVDs. These collections are delivered on a rotating schedule every four weeks, depending on the facility's needs. Home Delivery Service If you are a resident of Campbell County and cannot visit the library because of temporary or permanent illness or disability, you are eligible for our home delivery service. Materials available for delivery include regular print books, large print books, magazines, DVDs, audiobooks and CDs. Materials are selected based on your reading interests and needs. The Adult Outreach Services Assistant will deliver the materials to your home on a specified day. You may also sign up to have your materials delivered by mail for free.

facts.claim: IKEA Florence says customer parking is free. It locates this order point in Florence Square Shopping Center, across from Florence Mall.
facts.quote: IKEA Florence is located in the Florence Square Shopping Center in Florence, KY, across from the Florence Mall. Q. Does IKEA Florence offer free parking? Yes, IKEA Florence offers free parking for customers.

facts.claim: Visitors may browse the showroom without a planning appointment. Appointments for planning or purchasing can be booked ahead.
facts.quote: The IKEA Plan and order point is open for all visitors to browse our showroom and get inspiration and ideas for your home. Those who would like to plan or purchase can make an appointment in advance here

facts.claim: The branch offers one-to-one planning consultations in person or virtually, with goods shipped to the home. This describes a planning service, not a full self-service warehouse.
facts.quote: We are appointment-based, offering one-on-one in-person or virtual consultation services for any area of the home. The difference between an IKEA store and an IKEA Plan and order point is that you do not take products home with you. Instead, you discover the look and style for your living space, design it with the help of an IKEA planner, and then have the products shipped directly to your home.

facts.claim: The Florence page advertises curbside pickup. It asks visitors to come inside for help ordering unavailable items to this location, with pickup as early as the next day; it does not explain bay location or arrival check-in.
facts.quote: Visit the IKEA Florence Plan & order point with pick-up to place an order for curbside pick-up! Need something not available in-store? Come inside and speak with one of our friendly co-workers. We’ll help you order what you need and have it delivered to this location, ready for pick-up as early as the next day.

facts.claim: The Florence page lists Click & Collect as free for IKEA Family members and $2 for non-members, and says to ask a coworker for details.
facts.quote: Click & Collect at IKEA is free for IKEA Family members. Not an IKEA Family member? Click & Collect is $2. See a co-worker for details.

facts.claim: Physical returns are not accepted at this order point. IKEA directs customers to another nearby store or its contact service.
facts.quote: We are unable to accept physical returns at the IKEA Plan and order point. Any IKEA items purchased can be conveniently returned by visiting our other nearby store locations or by contacting us here

facts.claim: The Florence FAQ says there is no restaurant, bistro or Swedish food market at the order point.
facts.quote: There is not a restaurant, bistro or Swedish food market at the Plan and order point.

facts.claim: The branch FAQ says there is no self-service warehouse for larger furniture, but says some home furnishings can be taken home the same day. This differs from the same page’s introduction saying there is no stock; confirm before making a collection trip.
facts.quote: There is no self-serve warehouse at this location to purchase and take home larger furniture items. You can shop and take home many amazing home furnishings the same day, and our entire range of furniture and furnishings is available for purchase and can be delivered directly to your home.

facts.claim: The November 12, 2025 launch announcement gave 7735 Mall Road as the planned address. See the listing’s caution about the current branch page’s different address.
facts.quote: IKEA Florence will be located in the Florence Square shopping center at 7735 Mall Road, Florence, KY 41042, covering 4,200 square feet of leased retail space.

facts.claim: Publix’s chain pickup guidance says to order online and select the store and pickup time. Drive there during that time window or after receiving the ready notification.
facts.quote: Simply place your order online at publix.com/shop . Once your order is complete, you will be prompted to select a time to pick up your order at your selected Publix. Drive to the Publix location you selected, during your selected time window, or after you receive a notification that your order is ready.

facts.claim: Publix’s chain instructions say to park in a designated curbside space and notify the store in the Publix Delivery and Curbside app or by calling the number on the sign. Give your name; an associate brings the order out and loads the car.
facts.quote: Park in the designated Publix Curbside parking space and notify the store through the Publix Delivery and Curbside app or call the store using the number on the sign. Give the Publix associate your name, and they will bring your order out and load it into your car.

facts.claim: Publix’s chain FAQ directs customers to the ordering site for item prices and the fees for delivery or curbside pickup. Check those costs before ordering.
facts.quote: Prices for individual items are indicated on the website. Visit publix.com/shop for details on fees associated with delivery and curbside pickup services.
